detachments.name: Kabalite Strike Force
detachments.unlock: When a model with the Kabals Trait is selected to fill a Command Slot, then the Player may add a Kabalite Strike Force to the Army instead of the options available in the Crusade Force Organization Chart.
restrictions: Only Units with the Kabals Trait may be selected to fill Slots in this Detachment.
detachments.note: Slot roles read from the icons, matched against the role icon printed on each unit page (the book has no icon legend).
